Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
ashur.a...@gmail.com wrote:
>After some ten years of posting, my friend Ashur have been banned from
>this newsgroup by it´s creator/administrator.

Nope. Usenet doesn't work like that.

Your news provider - Google, presumably - might have decided to bar you
access to their service, but that's entirely different. There is no
central authority that can ban you from an unmoderated newsgroup such as
rec...jyhad.

--
James Coupe

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:

This newsgroup is unmoderated (as noted in the FAQ...) There isn't any
way to be banned from the newsgroup. It is possible that his ISP
doesn't pick it up anymore (although if he is reading it with
google.groups, that isn't an issue either). And possible that
something is broken somewhere. But he certainly isn't banned.

And why is "Ashur's friend" posting as ashur.ashur? Suspicious...

-Peter
